name: Por Mai Lek Tai Song Tua
summary: When Panu's twin children Oley and Nene want Karaked, a teacher, to be their stepmom, the two start to play cupid. But their obstacles are General Samurjai, Karaked's father who tries every way to intervene between Panu and Karaked and the twin's maternal grandmother Khun Nuankae, who wants to take custody of the two children. So Panu must use his love and sincerity to prove to everyone.

name: Yuming Stories
summary: Adapted from the novel short story collection "Yuming Tribute Stories" inspired by the songs of Matsutoya Yumi.

name: Mon Rak Luk Thung 2567
summary: Khlao a poor farmer with a lot of debt falls in love with a young woman from a rich family named Thong Kwao but their relationship is not approved by Thong Kwao's parents because Khlao is poor. Thong Kwao was sent to Bangkok by her parents, so Thong Kwao could get a man who really matched her parents' wishes. Khlao also has many women who want to get his love and this creates many misunderstandings that can separate the love between Khlao and Thong Kwao.

name: The Theory of Original Family or Crime
Angels and Guards
summary: Bounty hunter Shen Bingfan joins the Northern Bureau of the Jinyiwei (Imperial Guard), the emperor's elite secret guard, to uncover the truth behind her father's wrongful case. There, she becomes a female Jinyiwei agent alongside Cheng Xintian and Hua Mange. As they investigate a string of bizarre cases, she forms unlikely alliances with the mysterious proprietor Chang Beiming, the lowly handyman Xu Duoyu, and others. Together, they take on corrupt power, solve impossible mysteries, and gradually uncover the truth behind her father's murder years ago...

name: A Summer Odyssey
summary: Four teens with distinct personalities form a band and navigate the challenges of trust, identity, and emotional growth. As mysterious events unfold, their bonds are tested, revealing deeper truths about love and connection.

name: Ancient Street
summary: Adapted from the novel "Gu Jie" (古街) by Liu Yu Xin (刘育新).

name: An Eternal Thought
summary: Bai Xiaochun, a kind-hearted and free-spirited, always uses his own methods to help people who he thinks is in need. This leads to many hilarious situations, and he is regarded by villagers as a rebellious kid. After he gets into the famous Ling Xi Sect, he meets a few like-minded friends, each with their own capabilities and quirks. Together, they form a team set to uphold justice. A few years later, Bai Xiaochun grows up and become a hot-blooded and responsible young hero. Bai Xiaochun sets out on a journey to restore world peace and in the process, gains friendship and love.

name: This Thriving Land
summary: This emotional epic is set against the background of rural land changes in southern Shandong and spanning the period from late 1926 to 1944. Focusing on the legend of women's growth, it displays the farmers' difficult journey of survival and development under feudal rule, as well as their inseparable attachment to the land from generation to generation.

name: A Forbidden Marriage
summary: It is adapted from the novel "Senior, You Will Lose Me Easily Like This" by Yiren KuiKui and tells the story of a demonic sect saint who is reborn and falls in love with a righteous male protagonist. Wangyue, the enchanting and unpredictable saint of the Holy Fire Sect, miraculously survives a deadly situation and transforms into a destitute orphan. She is determined to fulfill her unrealized wish: to be united with Yang Qing, an elder of a prestigious righteous sect. With this desire in her heart, Wangyue, who has been given a second chance at life, coincidentally meets and gets to know Yang Qing. Eventually, the two join forces in the martial world, working together to defeat the real mastermind behind the chaos. They strive to bring about reconciliation between the Holy Fire Sect and the righteous sect, bringing peace and prosperity to the world.

name: A Dream Within a Dream
summary: What would you do if you accidentally found yourself inside the world of a script, playing the role of a tragic female lead used and discarded by the villainous male lead, even tortured to death? For Song Xiaoyu, the answer is obvious: run as far away as possible. She had the perfect escape plan, but reality said otherwise. Every time she tries to change the storyline or marry a supporting male character, she becomes trapped in a never-ending loop full of "bugs," dying in 108 unique and absurd ways. In short, the game was over for her the moment it began. Eventually, Xiaoyu comes to a painful realization: no matter how hard she tries, the "plot" always pulls her back to the male lead, Nan Heng, forcing her to re-enact the script's iconic scenes again and again. In this paper-thin world, so many characters are shackled by predestined roles. Some are imprisoned in palace intrigues, others are confined in grand aristocratic mansions. Some are trapped in toxic rivalries among women, while others endlessly pursue power and status. Some yearn for love and freedom but can only dance in fear, bound by invisible chains. Some dream of soaring like mighty birds, only to lose their spirit amid the monotony of daily life. This drama portrays the struggle of ordinary individuals fighting against a fate that was scripted from the very beginning.

name: Påskekrimlekene
summary: A mysterious killer forces presenter Markus Neby and ten celebrities to tackle the traditional Easter in a non-traditional way - or die.

name: Jon Kwa Ja Dai Ruk Gun
summary: Funny, charming, and sarcastic Mueang is a 27-year-old outspoken eco-warrior geologist who enjoys tree-hugging as a pastime. While Apo/View is a 27-year-old architect who wears her heart on her sleeve, is overworked and recently dumped by her company, and goes on the deep end when her boyfriend cheats on her. Cupid strikes the moment Mueang and View set eyes on each other, sparks fly... one innocent conversation leads to another, and they unexpectedly spend the night together. Their overnight rendezvous in a cozy camper by the sea was chaotically unforgettable. But the following day, when Mueang gets up, he finds that Apo had left without leaving any details of her contact or whereabouts.

name: In Memoriam
summary: Julien, Judith, Mathieu and Lucile, almost orphans, reject their father, Paul-Émile de Léry, after the suicide of their mother. An unexpected event will brings them together again: to inherit his colossal fortune, they must enter into a ruthless competition. The trials unearth family secrets, rekindling the pain of the past. Even in death, Paul-Émile exercises his power over them.

name: Drama Queens
summary: Drama Queens promises an authentic and aspirational glimpse into the lives of some of the nation's favourite stars from three of the most iconic soaps in the UK – Hollyoaks, Coronation Street and Emmerdale, taking viewers beyond the scripted drama of the screen, and into the real lives of soap personalities.

name: Waowon Rak
summary: Cherkwan has the same fate as Miss. Cinderella who had both an evil stepmother and jealous older sister waiting to snatch what rightfully belongs to her. She has to flee to Phaya Lo mountain to escape being duped into a marriage and set up for the murder of the groom. To ask for aid, she intends to run to wealthy landowner Chalaybutr, the older brother of a friend who'd fallen for her before they'd ever met, but mistakenly meets another wealthy man, Khetkham, handsome and cool but rutheless. Cherkwan's princess-like beauty reignites the flames of love and resentment between the two eternal enemies, Khetkham and Chalaybutr.

name: Hanasaki Mai ga Damattenai
summary: Hanasaki Mai works as a teller for a branch of Tokyo Daiichi Bank. Suddenly, she gets transferred to the Tokyo Daiichi Bank's headquarters office. Her job is to fix problems that arise at its various local branch offices. Hanasaki Mai has the type of personality where if she believes she is right, she cannot keep quiet about it or give up. At her new department, she sees many mistakes that take place inside the bank, which she never noticed before.

name: Songkhram Somrot
summary: Buabongkot thought that after fifteen years of marriage and stability with Poramet, nothing would change. That is, until the day she learned of her husband's affair. Instead of accepting she's lost, Buabongkot decides to stand up for justice in her marriage.

name: Laorchan
summary: La-ojan has just graduated from France and applies to be a secretary for Mom Luang Phuthanet Juthathep. Her intention is to steal the "Ajna Chakra" necklace, a precious piece of jewellery from Wiang Phu Kham which was sent to be displayed at the JT Center Mall owned by Phuthanet. During this time, their relationship slowly builds. He has fallen in love with her at first sight, and La-ojan grows gradually more attracted to him too.

name: Ngao Kammathep
summary: Tien has been raised as a boy all her life because Kamontat, her ill-willed father, swapped her with the family's gardener/caretaker's son in his estate in Hua hin, leaving behind a ring strung in a necklace as key to her true identity. Before Grandpa Thaksasoot died, he declared that he wanted a boy to carry the family name since Thorn, her father's brother, who also later died, can't have children. Years later, Kamontat searched for Tien because he doesn't want his adopted son to inherit the money. Thorn and Rome were best friends and one fateful day, Rome met Tien and saved her from an unlikely situation; not knowing at first that she is a girl, brought her home and took care of her. Then Rome discovered Tien's true identity as the missing heiress to the Thaksasoot family fortune. Some years back, Rome was financially ruined by Kamontat. Driven by revenge, Rome kept the truth to himself but later admitted it and helped to get Tien back to her rightful place in the family.

name: Jaiphisut
summary: Ronnachak has the chance to meet Jaiphisut who is his childhood friend because she is a teacher for Sunida, his dead friend's sister who asked him to take care of her before he died. Jaiphisut is unhappy to meet him because she can remember how he teased her. She needs to make up the relationship between Sunida and Pemnuch, unaware that they become friends and try to bring Ronnachak and Jaiphisut back together.

name: Praai Pikart
summary: A scary criminal and the cop who was trying to catch him need to collab together to face supernatural forces and join the fight against a powerful organization, while also getting involved with the daughter of a scientist and a female criminal.

name: Key to a Fortune
summary: What would you do if you inherited a home that you didn't know existed? Jean Johansson follows the hunt for the rightful heirs to properties, but will they keep or sell their key to a fortune?

name: Rising Tides - Ireland's Future in a Warmer World
summary: Philip Boucher-Hayes goes on an extraordinary journey across the planet to see how climate change is already affecting the world and to find out what it means for us in Ireland.

name: Gray Shelter
summary: Cha SooHyuk is focused only on his survival, without any grand goal. He reunites with Lee YoonDae, who he was very close with. YoonDae was living with his girlfriend but now has nowhere to go. They end up living together.

name: Boys Be Brave
summary: JinWoo, is a young man who finds himself living with his crush, KiSub, who entered his home uninvited and crashed on his couch for a little too long. The narrative also explores the relationship between Sunny and InHo, who hold onto a secret from their high school days.

previousepisode.name: A promise to recognize it at first "sight"

name: Jakten på förstasidan
summary: In Jakten på förstasidan, we get to follow the actors Emma Molin and Eric Stern on an adventurous journey through Sweden to work as guest reporters for six different local newspapers. Their ambition is to reach the front page by finding the local news that engages the most. They soon discover that the task is much more difficult than they had expected.

name: Eccentric Romance
summary: Jay, an international student from Thailand, comes to Korea to see his friend Sung Hoon. The two enrolled in the same college "Health and Happiness" class, and need to submit a physical body assessment for their final project. While Sung Hoon already works out regularly, Jay isn't in the greatest shape, and he struggles in the gym. Enter Jin Wook, a personal trainer who takes a special interest in Jay, much to Sung Hoon's displeasure. However, there's something strange about Jin Wook – despite his kindness toward Jay, suspicions begin to rise that Jin Wook may be involved in a murder and missing person incident. Is there a happy ending in store for Jay and Sung Hoon, or will Jay's budding relationship with Jin Wook cost him an unspeakable price?

name: Rinkai!
summary: Women's bicycle racing was born during the post-war period of turmoil. It has been several decades since its short competitive history came to an end after only 15 years. Women's bicycle racing has been revived as the Rinkai League. With the birth of a major star who is active all over the world, many feel unprecedented excitement. Invincible Queen, Ibushi Silver Veteran, an athlete who has reached the pinnacle in other sports. The challengers came with only big dreams in their hearts even though they had no experience in sports.

name: Whisper Me a Love Song
summary:
Yori Asanagi is a mature girl in many ways but is still pure when it comes to romance. That sentiment is proven when an underclassman, Himari Kino, suddenly confesses love to her after her band performance at the freshman opening ceremony.

Confused and surprised, Yori asks her friends for consultation, but they tease her by saying that she is experiencing love. Yori soon makes up her mind and tries to return Himari's feelings, but in a twist of events, she realizes that what Himari loved was not her, but her music!

As Yori continues to pursue her love for Himari, she promises to make Himari fall for her. However, will this passionate love bloom or remain unrequited?

name: Connection
summary: The crumbling friendship of friends is revealed as they uncover the death of a high school friend who left behind a five billion won insurance money.

name: Universo Z
summary: Universo Z is a children's series that mixes live action and animation to present the adventures of Z (a girl) and two of her friends Taby (a tablet) and Sir PC (a computer). Together they address various issues and challenges in a fun and playful way.

name: Sat Suea
summary: The story of a young policeman who was falsely accused of a crime he didn't commit by a more senior corrupted policeman. During his time in prison, he comes to meet a few people with similar stories as him. Together, they break out of jail with a mission to fight against injustice and take down the corrupted.

name: Futekisetsu ni mo Hodo ga Aru!
summary: Ichiro is a PE teacher in 1986 feared by his students for a "tough love" approach, harsh tongue and frequently "inappropriate" behavior. He's also a dad trying to raise a rebellious daughter after having lost his wife to illness. When he gets transported in time to 2024, he encounters modern sensibilities that teach him about empathy, but also gives people of today reason to rethink their own political correctness in this time traversing comedy about change.

name: A Wonderful Journey
summary: During the fast-changing 1990s, the family who held "Wonderful Taxi" and their drivers in Chiayi, even when they encountered various difficulties and problems, they still kept going with their own way.

name: Discrètes
summary: Macha and Gaby are housekeepers of an office tower. The night Macha saves Gaby from the hands of her aggressor, the girls start a quest to do justice for themselves.

name: HeeSu in Class 2
summary: The drama is based on a popular webtoon of the same name. The story is about the youthful romance of HeeSu, an ordinary 18-year old boy, and his neighbor who has a secret.

name: Talking Friends
summary: Talking Tom stars in Disney's newest show, Talking Friends, along with Talking Ben, Talking Ginger, Talking Gina and Talking Pierre.

name: Hear Your Heart
summary: The flower shop owner and love consultant, Su Yi, has heterochromatic pupils. She can hear others' thoughts. By a twist of fate, she meets Lin Xufeng, who has returned to start a business in his homeland. After coincidentally encountering each other several times, they gradually develop feelings for each other. Unexpectedly, their true love's kiss unlocks memories sealed for a thousand years. As their memories of past life grudges and affections awaken, what should they do in this present life?

name: Love at Second Glance
summary: It tells the story of the female protagonist Zhong Qing, who, in order to stand out in the "workplace survival battle", spares no effort or cost to "only talk about money". But one day, there was a sudden incident, and Zhong Qing's position as director disappeared instantly, only adding a special skill that could see everyone's balance. The new director, Bu Yi, saw the new official take office, and this pair of happy enemies went from their strained relationship to the sparks of love sparked by friction, and finally felt the true meaning of life.

name: George Poveromo's World of Saltwater Fishing
summary: George Poveromo targets the most popular saltwater game fish.

previousepisode.name: The Papa Joe's Experience: Islamorada, Florida Keys

name: Jens i Mongolia
summary: A newly in love Jens is torn between a desire for adventure and missing his girlfriend when he sets out on a crazy journey on horseback in Mongolia.

name: Хлеб
summary: Four episodes of the documentary project will tell about the role of bread in world and Russian history, science and economics, geopolitics, as well as how it affects our health.

name: Nong Mia
summary: Many women find the protagonist, Ekkapop very attractive, yet is already engaged to Ngamnek, who he is about to marry. On the eve of the wedding, in a nightclub, by chance, Ekkapop ends up in an affair with Fuengfah, Ngamnek's half sister.

name: Air Fryers Made Easy
summary: In this cooking series, Alexis Conran aims to prove how easy it can be to prepare decent meals in an air fryer, even for the most amateur of chefs.

name: Predator vs Prey
summary: Wildlife series offering new perspectives on how predators such as lions, crocodiles and cheetahs stalk, chase and bring down their prey.

name: Spinal Destination
summary: Tessa Rivers' busy life is turned upside down when a mysterious illness leaves her paralysed from the waist down. Tessa is sent to Goldfield's Spinal Unit, where she becomes determined to walk again - by any means necessary.

name: Emergency Couple
summary: The tumultuous feelings of a divorced couple are rekindled when they become reunited years later as interns at the same hospital.

name: Chatham Islanders
summary: Experience the community, the history, the isolation, and the connection of life on the remote Chatham Islands, where the land and sea govern the day to lives of the inhabitants.

name: Strait to the Plate
summary: Aaron Fa'aoso sets out on a journey to discover signature Torres Strait Islander cuisine, providing a snapshot of the food, people, and life of the tropical region.

name: WWII: Women on the Frontline
summary: Defying expectations, overcoming prejudices, and often outperforming their counterparts, these are the courageous, and unwritten stories of the women who fought the Nazis. This remarkable documentary explores the daring and unknown histories of the remarkable pilots, journalists, guerrillas and spies who fought, flew, and died across Britain, Germany, France and beyond during World War II.

name: The Defenders
summary: Adapted from the novel "Sheng Shi Shou Hu" (生死守护) by Zhang Ping (张平).

name: Blemish Flaw
summary: Mystery video blogger Yang Zhenghui uncovers a disturbing connection between the long-term disappearance of his ex-girlfriend, Liu Wei, and a ceramist named Zeng Jie. A fire that broke out at Zeng Jie's studio a year ago appears to have concealed crucial secrets about Liu Wei's fate. Now, Zeng Jie is scheming to murder his wife and take over her fortune. As Yang Zhenghui digs deeper, the logic behind the truth slowly surfaces...

name: Runaway Princess
summary: One missing girl. Three very different lives. As the search pulls them together, each girl faces a choice that could break her—or save her. Above ground, the city gleams; below, a maze of dark tunnels hides its secrets. One girl walks that line alone, through pain and buried truths, until she uncovers what really happened. But finding the answer is only half the fight. The other half? Finding herself, and a way back to the light.

name: Twelve Letters
summary: Twelve mysterious letters, thirty-five years of unending anticipation. This drama focuses on the fate and romance of a small-town youth wrapped in a fantasy shell with suspense as bait and emotions at its core. It breaks traditional narrative patterns by introducing a unique dual-time-space interaction mechanism. The unpredictable weather and the blackboard in an abandoned classroom open a channel connecting two-time spaces, creating an enthralling and suspenseful experience.

name: Wonder Wall
summary: A terribly unlucky young couple stumbles into a massive villa by chance and accidentally discovers a huge sum of hidden fortune. But when trouble hits, they can no longer tell — is this a dream come true or a nightmare unfolding？

name: Be Passionately in Love
summary: In the cicada-filled summer in the rainy southern city of Qingyi, Xu Zhi, the "Ruijun Dark Horse," meets Chen Luzhou, the "Naked Score Topper." A misunderstanding kicks off the fiery romance between "Zhi" and "Poet Chen."

name: Coming to Myself
summary:
A female detective, You Mingxu, from Jiangrong City, delves into western Sichuan to investigate a series of murders. Along the way, she encounters Yin Feng, a criminal psychology professor who is injured and suffering from amnesia. The two form a detective duo. With his mind reverted to a youthful state, Yin Feng, innocent and passionate, gradually opens up You Mingxu's heart, which had been closed off due to losing her mother at a young age. During their investigation, Yin Feng displays exceptional skills in criminal psychological analysis, while You Mingxu relies on her extensive experience and keen intuition. With Yin Feng's help, they solve multiple cases, growing from strangers to a well-coordinated team, and eventually, they develop feelings for each other.

 Yin Feng regains his memory, revealing a cold exterior but still harboring deep feelings for You Mingxu. However, he deduces that his own brother might be the one who killed You Mingxu's mother years ago. To unravel the mystery of You Mingxu's mother's death from nineteen years ago, the two uncover the truth. Ultimately, the long-buried secrets come to light, and the real culprit is brought to justice.

Adapted from the web novel "Dai Wo You Zui Shi" (待我有罪时) by Ding Mo (丁墨).

name: Si Jin
summary: Jiang Si, the fourth lady of Dongping Bo Mansion, is reborn after dying at the hands of her lover, Yu Jin. Determined to rewrite her fate, she breaks off her engagement, outsmarts her cruel aunt, opens a perfumery, and investigates a series of mysterious crimes. She reunites with Yu Jin, and despite their unresolved past, they join forces to change tragic destinies—saving her siblings and clearing her father's name. As they overcome hardships together, Jiang Si's feelings for Yu Jin rekindle, and they work hand in hand to protect the peace of the Zhou dynasty, embracing a lifetime of prosperity.

name: Chun Ri Yan
summary: Adapted from the web novel "Spring Banquet" (春日宴) by Bai Lu Cheng Shuang (白鹭成双).

name: Serendipity
summary:
Jian Mingshu, the daughter of the Jian family, survives a family massacre after accidentally falling off a cliff and losing her memory. Rescued by her love, Lu Chang, they journey together to the capital for exams. As Mingshu investigates her mysterious origins, she faces challenges but is secretly protected by Lu Chang. Through shared trials, their bond deepens, and they ultimately confirm their love, deciding to spend their lives together.

Adapted from the novel "Bang Xia Gui Xu (榜下贵婿)" by Luo Ri Qiang Wei (落日薔薇).

name: Donkey Kong
summary:
Donkey Kong has escaped from the circus. He is on the lam, and Mario and Pauline are chasing the ape.

As with the original game, Donkey Kong will often grab Pauline and Mario has to save her. 

Plots typically centered on them encountering crime with the villains conning the slow-witted Donkey Kong into doing their work and Mario and Pauline exposing the truth. After Mario and Pauline reveal the truth to Donkey Kong, the three of them team up to stop the antagonists' plans followed by Donkey Kong evading Mario and Pauline again.

name: Bury the Hatchet
summary: This light-hearted court-style show will bring two warring parties together to help them "bury the hatchet". Hosted by a notable Atlanta legal figure serving as the "judge" and a group of comedians and influencers as the "jury," the two groups will present their cases and the judge and jury will help them settle the beef.

name: Axel Wagner und die Klimakrise
summary: Species extinction, heavy rain, scorching heat, ... - science journalist and biologist Axel Wagner uses impressive film footage to show how our environment is changing and explains what we can do to avert the dramatic consequences of the climate crisis.

name: Demon Lord 2099
summary: The cyberpunk metropolis Shinjuku—a massive city-state bedecked with neon signs, towering skyscrapers, and the latest cutting-edge technology. It is here, in year 2099 of the Fused Era, where the legendary Demon Lord Veltol has his second coming five centuries in the making. But this landscape is nothing like the one he conquered all those years ago, for the fusion of magic and engineering has elevated civilization to dazzling, unprecedented heights. Veltol may have been reduced to a historical footnote, but make no mistake...this brave new world will be his for the taking!

previousepisode.name: 私がずっと欲しかったもの

name: Dossiers : Disparus
summary: Four cops form the "Disappearances" group, specializing in the search for missing people whose cases are considered worrying and therefore urgent. Their area of intervention includes Paris and its immediate suburbs.

name: Le Destin du Docteur Calvet
summary: Jean Calvet, a doctor practicing at the Saint-Charles clinic, married Isabelle, a former patient whom he saved from Hodgkin's disease. Seductions, threats and blackmail are part of his daily life.

name: Chou Nogizaka Star Tanjou!
summary: In 'Chou Nogizaka Star Tanjou!', Nogizaka46 5th generation members together with MCs Ozwald challenge singing famous Showa and Heisei songs and newly also full skits.

name: Thomas & Friends: Big World! Big Adventures!
summary: A young train engine and his friends work hard on the railways.

name: Johnson & Knopfler's Music Legends
summary:
Musicians don't come much bigger or more successful than Brian Johnson and Mark Knopfler - lead singers of AC/DC and Dire Straits respectively. These two legends of rock have sold a staggering 300 million records between them, toured for more than 40 years and have each left their own indelible mark on our cultural history.

Now, after a lifetime in music, Brian and Mark are taking a moment to reflect by sharing their incredible knowledge, experience and insights with each other - and the world.

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress: Pathway to Victory
summary: The teaching ministry of American Southern Baptist pastor and television host Dr Robert Jeffress. He is a Senior Minister of the First Baptist Church in Dallas as well as a Fox News contributor.

name: D. James Kennedy Ministries Presents: Truths That Transform
summary: Topical discussions, feature stories, incisive commentary, and timely excerpts from the powerful messages of D. James Kennedy.

name: Coral Ridge Ministries Presents: Truths That Transform
summary: Topical discussions, feature stories, incisive commentary, and timely excerpts from the powerful messages of D. James Kennedy.

name: Actor:eal
summary: Actor:eal depicts the story of two actors portraying as friends who have known for 10 years, with one harboring feelings towards the other. A new character introduces hinting a bigger picture between the two actor—it is still acting or being real?

name: Donkey Kong Jr.
summary: Donkey Kong Jr. is sad to find that his father is running away from Mario and the circus. He befriends a greaser nicknamed "Bones" who has a motorcycle and offers to help Junior by finding his dad together.

name: Nogizaka Star Tanjou!
summary: 'Nogizaka Star Tanjou!' is a show in which Nogizaka46 4th generation members together with MCs Pekopa challenge singing traditional idol songs.

name: New Nogizaka Star Tanjou!
summary: So far, they have challenged themselves with "wandering travel" in "Nogizaka Doko e" and "comedy" in "Nogizaka Skits". The fourth generation, who are the future of Nogizaka46. The next challenge for these girls is... Showa era songs! They will sing covers of hit songs from the past! They'll also perform serious duets with big-name male singers!

name: Adresse Malmø
summary: The world's biggest music show is approaching, and we present the songs and artists who will take part in the Eurovision Song Contest.

name: WWE: Next Gen
summary: Produced by John Cena, this series chronicles athletes vying to become the next WWE Superstars. The process will challenge them, but the biggest tests they face will be ones they create on their own.

name: Together: Tr3ble Winners
summary: In this sports documentary, Manchester City FC offers a behind-the-scenes look into their 2022-23 season.

name: The Faulkner Focus
summary: Emmy-winning journalist Harris Faulkner provides the latest news driving the day with insightful analysis and interviews with top newsmakers.

name: Beat the Bridge
summary: Featuring an enormous interactive bridge that dares players to cross by stepping on the right answers to challenging trivia questions. Each step forward puts money in the team's bank, with bonus money for each successful crossing. However, the team gets to keep the money only if it can "beat the bridge" by returning one of its players back across before time expires in an exciting end game.

name: Tic Tac Dough
summary: Tic Tac Dough is an update of NBCUniversal's classic format originally created by Robert Noah. The show is hosted by the incomparable Brooke Burns ("Master Minds", "The Chase"), who guides two contestants as they compete to place three of their marks in a row on the giant trivia board. After three rounds, the winning player moves on to face the dragon in the grand prize round, where the dragon moves strategically on the board to block the player's ability to make three-in-a-row and take home $10,000.

name: Сделка
summary: You need to come to the shopping and entertainment center "Dostyk Plaza" and buy at least "two items". You have to make a bet on this "two items" show and correctly answer the questions sent by our viewers from all over the country.

name: Cuaderno de Campo
summary: Cuaderno de Campo is a documentary series that shows the best kept secrets of the Iberian fauna. On this journey, Juan Antonio Rodríguez Llano, naturalist and director of numerous nature documentaries, together with his expert film crew, will reveal the untold stories of Spain's wildlife. With a surprising and fun approach, each episode will show the life of a different wild protagonist, a star who will share his most intimate life and behaviors.

name: Zhu Tian Ji
summary: Teenage boy Lin Fei was unable to practice martial arts due to a defect in his meridians. After witnessing his master and his best friend die in the battle in the Black Abyss, he began to practice an ancient art of artifact refinement. He vowed to avenge them and hunt down the leader of the Black Abyss, even if it cost him his own life. A mysterious power revived him in a new era, and Lin Fei was determined to rebuild his sect and make it flourish.

name: Family Reservations
summary: Family Reservations follows culinary pioneer and world-renowned restaurateur Maren Winter, who is nearing retirement. Each of her three daughters is eager to take the reins of running her restaurant empire, the Winter Group. Ruled by her deep insecurities about becoming irrelevant, Maren pits her three daughters against each other, beginning her own dangerous descent into madness and starting the Winter sisters on their journey to freedom.

name: The Power of Film
summary:
THE POWER OF FILM is a 6-part television event from legendary UCLA film Professor Emeritus Howard Suber, analyzing why certain films have remained both popular and memorable for generations.

He uncovers mysteries, dispels myths, and explains with clarity and humor the defining principles and inner workings of some of the most powerful and beloved films of all time.   Scenes from hundreds of these much-loved movies are featured throughout.

name: The Chair Company
summary: After an embarrassing incident at work, suburban family man William Ronald Trosper finds himself investigating a far-reaching conspiracy.

previousepisode.name: Minnie Mouse coming back wasn't on my bingo card.

name: High Hopes
summary: High Hopes follows Slava, Mishka, and their hilarious employees at their Hollywood-based cannabis dispensary - MMD - as they navigate the pitfalls, pleasures, and potpourri of potheads that come with running one of the fastest-growing cannabis companies in California.

name: America Reports
summary: A look at the latest news and headlines with Sandra Smith and John Roberts

name: Jesse Watters Primetime
summary: Jesse Watters brings his fresh take to Primetime. Each night, he'll speak with newsmakers from across the country and give Americans a show where straight talk is the only talk, and the obvious will never be left unsaid.

name: Ожоги любви
summary: The Savelyev family lives and knows no troubles until an unexpected turn occurs in their fate. Vsevolod and his wife Galina learn that their son Ignat is falling in love with his mother's former friend Larisa. Meanwhile, a mysterious man in a leather cap named Alexander is trying to get home, and no one even suspects what will happen when he finally reaches his destination.

name: Fabricante de ovnis
summary: Fernando, a native of Argentina, arrives in Salgueiro, an almost abandoned town in the heart of Galicia, looking for his grandfather's birth certificate which he needs to apply for Spanish citizenship. While there, the locals try to convince him to stay in the town and assume the role of its leader, a role that Fernando's grandfather successfully occupied until he fled to Argentina for no apparent reason. Fernando believes the town could tap into UFO tourism to revive its fortunes. The entire community is at the command of its new leader, awaiting the arrival of aliens...

name: Zussen
summary: Three women come to the notary, turn out to be half-sisters and have to divide the inheritance (a farm) together. In the meantime, the question arises about their half-sisterhood and how their father died.

nextepisode.name: Misschien was het toch niet zo'n goed idee

name: I Can Cook
summary: Katy invites a group of young cooks into her kitchen to learn about food and cook up their own tasty treats.

name: I Can Cook - On the Go
summary: I Can Cook - On the Go focuses on creating healthy sweet and savoury snacks, all of which help give us the energy to enjoy a wide range of outdoor activities. Katy travels around the country in Horace, her kitchen campervan, helping children create and prepare healthy food. With songs to sing, actions to join in with and mouth-watering recipes to try at home, I Can Cook - On the Go will make healthy eating and outdoor activities fun and accessible for families to enjoy together.

previousepisode.name: A Special Surprise: Funky Beet Muffin and Surprise Party

name: Highspeed Etoile
summary: In the near future, a next-generation racing event called NEX Race is announced, changing the world of racing. New technology has made racing at over 500 km/h safe, changing racing on the world stage completely. Rin Rindou, who once dreamed of being a ballet dancer, had given up her dream due to an injury, became a NEET and lives with her grandmother. However, one day she is suddenly thrown into the world of next-generation racing.

name: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain
summary: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain is the story of two strangers getting married and falling in love. Priya is a happy-go-lucky woman in her early 30s, not married so far, and quite sure that she wouldn't be able to get married ever. She takes tuition for college students and is happy with the world. Ram Kapoor, a wealthy man in his early 40s, is a ruthless entrepreneur who also believes that he has missed the bus of marriage. But as fate would have it, they bump into each other through a minor car accident which hurts their egos more than their vehicles and then after a series of miscommunications and misunderstandings, destiny contrives once again to get the two married. What more surprises await Ram and Priya? Will they fall in love? To get these answers, watch Bade Achhe Lagte Hain...!

name: The Proof Is Out There: Military Mysteries
summary: The Proof Is Out There: Military Mysteries. Combat veterans Rudy Reyes and Ronnie Adkins unravel the mysteries behind the strangest and most controversial images, sounds, and documents from the modern history of war. Mysteries span the modern era of warfare, including the World Wars, The Korean War, the Vietnam War, The Cold War, The Gulf War, and the conflicts of the 21st century. Assassinations caught on tape, exploding battleships, ghost planes, vanished soldiers, propaganda hoaxes, alleged cover-ups and conspiracies are analyzed and dissected by Reyes and Adkins, aided by a team of top experts, and former members of the military. Each episode lifts the veil of secrecy on the fog of war.

previousepisode.name: Project Iceworm, Mystery of Sea Lab, Soviet Night Witches & Weirdest Tank Ever

name: Прощание с иллюзиями
summary: A biographical film based on the best-selling book of the same name by Vladimir Pozner. A story about how an era influences a person's fate. And how a person himself changes over time: remains true to his values, makes compromises, becomes disillusioned with ideals, but at the same time continues to search for answers to eternal questions.

name: Ген танца
summary: A person celebrates his or her birthday with a set of genes that can see their own visual images сть и границы возможностей. Now the artist's talent and talent should prepare for his birthday. Do you like the dance or the money and the work you do?

name: Da Ponte pra Lá
summary: After her best friend Ícaro is found dead, aspiring rapper Malu sets out to unravel the truth behind his mysterious passing.

name: Galgos
summary: In the Somarriba family everything seems to be going well, but it only seems that way. The Galgo Group, the family business that has seen three generations grow, is going through its worst moment and everyone around it is looking to take advantage. The crisis in the sector, the imminent arrival of the sugar law and the lack of leadership of Emilio, president of Galgo since his father died, are shaking the company's future. So Gonzalo Díaz, after years of working alongside Emilio, sets out to implement his own plans for the company. The one neither of them counted on was Carmina, Gonzalo's wife and also heir to the group as Emilio's sister. In a turn of events, Carmina makes a unilateral decision and unleashes a family and business earthquake that will also affect her children Blanca, Guzmán, Jimena and Julián. Interests and power struggles separate them and Carmina will have to choose between saving the company or saving her family.

name: Destiny
summary:
While Nishimura Kanade was a 3rd grade middle school student, her father, who worked as a prosecutor, died in an incident. After her father's death, she and her mother moved to her mother's hometown in Nagano Prefecture. Nishimura Kanade wanted to become a prosecutor like her father, and she entered law school at a national university in Nagano Prefecture. There, she had 4 friends, including Nogi Masaki. They became really close friends and shared memorable experiences together. Due to a case involving a death, their relationship ended. 

12 years later, Nishimura Kanade is now 35 years old and works as a prosecutor in the Yokohama District Public Prosecutors' Office. Her boyfriend is Okuda Takashi, who works as a doctor, and they live together. One day, one of her law school classmates, who disappeared after the death case, appears in front of her. Nishimura Kanade must confront the suspicious death case from her law school days. This leads her to examine the truth behind her father's death from 20 years ago and also the secret faces of her friends.

name: Alle Gutta: Mjøndalen IF
summary: For the first time, the TV cameras have been given full access to a tipping league club for an entire year. Here we get to follow the coach, players and support staff both on the football pitch and at home in Norway's most down-to-earth football club.

name: Bleep
summary: Victor Sotberg, Robin "Rob the Sir" Hofset and Christopher "Chris" Robin Omdahl give us fun and exciting content from their crazy world.

name: A Brief History of the Future
summary: A Brief History of the Future is a unique six-part documentary series about our futures and how we can reimagine them. Hosted by renowned futurist Ari Wallach, the show invites viewers on a journey around the world that is filled with discovery, hope, and possibility about where we find ourselves today and what could come next.

name: False Face and True Feelings
summary: Ye Yifan, once an innocent youth, swears revenge after his family is slaughtered, transforming into the ruthless and enigmatic crime boss known as "Mr. Mo." It is in this guise that he encounters Xia Zhiqiu, a dancer. Thus begins a love game between hunter and prey. Ye Yifan gradually falls in love with Xia Zhiqiu due to her seduction, but he discovers that her true identity is Gu Qingyan, the daughter of his enemy. Meanwhile, to avenge her father, Gu Qingyan lays traps that Ye Yifan willingly falls into for the sake of love. As the two adversaries are entangled in a web of love and hate, genuine emotions surge beneath their masks. What fate awaits them, deeply in love yet torn apart by enmity?

name: Star Wars: Tales of the Empire
summary: Star Wars: Tales of the Empire is a six-episode journey into the fearsome Galactic Empire through the eyes of two warriors on divergent paths, set during different eras. After losing everything, young Nightsister Morgan Elsbeth navigates the expanding Imperial world toward a path of vengeance, while former Jedi Barriss Offee does what she must to survive a rapidly changing galaxy. The choices they make will define their destinies.

name: Madness Machayenge - India Ko Hasayenge
summary: Get ready for a rollercoaster ride as comedians present sketches, gags, roasts, spoofs and stand-up acts. Along with comedy champion Huma Qureshi and hosted by Harsh Gujral, Madness Machayenge features Snehil, Ankita Shrivastav, Paritosh Tripathi, Kushal Badrike, Inder Sahni, Gaurav Dubey and Kettan Singh.

name: Thapki Pyar Ki
summary: The bright and beautiful Thapki is pretty much perfect... except for one minor flaw - she stammers. But that doesn't hold her back. All she needs is an encouraging pat on the back, a 'thapki', which soon becomes her name. Over the course of the show, Thapki falls in love with Dhruv, but is duped into getting married to his brother, Bihaan. In spite of this cruel twist of fate, Thapki doesn't let her spirit fade and does all she can to be the ideal bahu. What does destiny hold for this charming girl with an unbeatable spirit?

name: Inside The Hilton: Park Lane
summary:
This warm and entertaining observational documentary series has unprecedented access behind the scenes to staff and guests at the 5-star London Hilton on Park Lane Hotel.

As the hotel celebrates its 60th anniversary, it's undergoing a multi-million-pound renovation during the busiest time of the year.

The series follows the characterful staff as they attempt to maintain a 5-star service for celebrities and VIPs, and celebrates some of the biggest events in Britain's social calendar. The series reveals a wealth of surprising stories of guests from around the world who have come to stay at one of London's most iconic hotels.

name: Macaque Island
summary: Run wild with two troops of long-tailed macaques that rule the forests of Singapore. Spy on turf wars, see alpha males battle for supremacy and explore the complex lives of these sassy primates.

name: Lake District Rescue
summary: From falls on the fells to mountainside mishaps, the Lake District Mountain Rescue Association head out to bring home the lost, injured and stricken.

name: Renovation Rescue
summary:
Vogue Williams and Luke Mabbott will pick up where the bad builders have left off, bringing their expertise, warmth and passion to help homeowners wanting to transform their home all by themselves. 

The series will follow ambitious renovations as Vogue and Luke share money-saving skills, offer design inspiration, and demonstrate simple DIY techniques anyone can try at home! Together they will prove just how easy, satisfying, and cost effective it can be to pick up a power tool and get your hands dirty!

name: Love Triangle UK
summary:
Love Triangle sees six singles choose between just two handpicked partners (suitors). Based on a connection made by texting only, the single and their chosen match meet on a blind date before taking the extraordinary step of moving in together, in the hope of fast-tracking their relationship.

What the singles don't know, is that the pursuit of a ‘happy ever after' comes with an explosive twist, when the rejected match arrives looking for love.

name: National Trust: Our Dream Farm with Matt Baker
summary: Who has what it takes to be entrusted with a Northumberland national treasure? Matt Baker follows the search for the new tenants of The National Trust's vacant Wallington Estate farm.

name: League of Universities: The Athlete Boys
Fei Zheng Chang Dong Wu Yan Jiu Zong Xin
Our Memories
summary: "Big Brother to Kids" Wang Huanyu, "Dancing Queen" Wei Xing, "Shop Heir" Han Shuai, "Quirky Girl" Guo Ting, and "Literary Scholar" Shi Wenke are childhood friends who grew up together on "Universe Street" in a small seaside town. In the senior year of high school, both the low-achieving students Wang Huanyu, Han Shuai and Guo Ting, and the academically-inclined Wei Xing and Shi Wenke are caught up in the uncertainties of their future. In the clash of growing pains and the ignorance of youth, they gradually mature. Youth years are like a battlefield, but as long as the people you care about are by your side, you have nothing to fear. In this year, the teenagers with different personalities and mutual attractions each go through a unique experience of joy and sorrow brought about by kinship, friendship and ignorant love. In the midst of hesitation and confusion, they carefully find their paths, guarding their own original aspirations and relentlessly striving towards new pursuits.

name: To the Wonder
summary: The drama is adapted from Li Juan's essay collection "My Altay". It tells the story of Li Wenxiu, a Han girl who grew up in Altay. The pursuit of her literary dreams in the big city is fraught with difficulties, so she reluctantly returns to her hometown to her mother who runs a small provision store. After meeting Kazakh boy Batay, Wenxiu gradually discovers the beauty of the local area.

name: Wild Ambition Bloom
summary: In 1916, Chu Shaohua marries Chen Dashun, the eldest son of the Chen family's pharmacy, to save her brother. With integrity and sharp business skills, she earns the respect of Chen's father and becomes the manager. After the sudden deaths of Chen's father and Dashun, the pharmacy passes to Chen Ershun, who squanders the family fortune, driving it to ruin. Through hardship, Chu Shaohua establishes Huashun Pharmacy to support the family. Just as she plans to start a new life with her first love, Xia Chu, Chen Ershun and his mother block her path. When bandits raid the Chen household, Chu loses her daughter and, devastated, leaves for Shanghai. There, her outstanding performance at Yongxin Department Store draws the attention of business talent Wen Zhiqiu, who invites her to co-found a new venture. Step by step, she rises to become a bold and trustworthy woman entrepreneur

name: Love & Crown
summary: In the Great Qi dynasty, young Emperor Xiao Huan assumes the alias Bai Chifan and draws close to Ling Cangcang, daughter of the Grand Tutor, to reclaim power from him and the Empress Dowager. Cangcang, the brave and righteous leader of the Fenglai Pavilion, joins him in investigating the Lingbi Sect. Their bond deepens into love, but her master's death sparks a fatal misunderstanding. Though they become Emperor and Empress, old wounds keep them apart. Refusing to abandon the truth, Cangcang endures betrayal and peril, only to discover Xiao Huan's silent devotion. Together, they restore peace, and prove that neither love nor the realm must be forsaken.

name: Assassin Lovers
summary: During the Republic of China, Feng Xiao, the adopted son of a wealthy businessman, and Lin Wan Xiu, the adopted daughter of a warlord, were married. But were assassins with hidden agendas. The two need to trust in love and resolve their misunderstandings and join forces to smash a conspiracy to sell national treasures.

name: Murder Case: The Digital Detectives
summary: The next generation crime series revealing the ground-breaking police techniques used to solve murders on Britain's streets.

name: Kerokko Demetan
summary: The story is about Demetan (Jonathan in the English version), a poor young frog living in Rainbow Pond with his mother and father (a toymaker), who becomes friends with a popular and sweet girl frog named Ranatan (known as Pookie and later Hilary in different English versions), despite the differences in their social standings: Ranatan is the daughter of the leader of Rainbow Pond (English name, Leopold), while Demetan and his parents are tree frogs, which make them automatic outcasts in the community. Together, Demetan and Ranatan enjoy many adventures.

name: Parents mode d'emploi
summary: Parents overwhelmed by the generation gap facing somewhat rebellious teenagers, from small conflicts between brothers and sisters to great joys: moments of life as a tribe in which everyone can find themselves.

name: Princess Nirvana
summary: When Changning Princess Chu Ziqian woke up, she turned into Lin Yan, the daughter of Lin Shangshu, sitting on the wedding sedan to marry the seventh prince Zhao Qing. Everyone thought that the Seventh Prince and Princess Changning were childhood sweethearts, but Chu Ziqian actually claimed that the Seventh Prince not only refused to marry and humiliated her, but also poisoned her. God has given this opportunity, and Chu Ziqian will definitely use Lin Yan's identity to take revenge.

name: Zui Jian Nv Fa Yi Yan Shi
summary: Tao Zhenyan, a trainee forensic doctor in the Republic of China, met Gu Nanchuan, a private detective, because of a murder case. Their fates were connected due to the emergence of the stamp demon serial killer, and they began to join forces to solve strange cases. Relying on Tao Zhenyan's excellent forensic knowledge and Gu Nanchuan's rigorous reasoning, one case after another cleared up the fog to reveal the truth. Thousands of clues between the cases point to the stamp devil's reappearance in the world. Back then, Tao Zhenyan's brother was sentenced to be a stamp demon and lost his life. For this, her family was infamous for the murderer's blood. Gu Nanchuan's parents were both killed by the demon stamp, and the two of them were at odds with the stamp demon. We live together, and a confrontation between good and evil begins...

name: A Thousand Lies and a Hundred Plans
summary: At the wedding ceremony of Li Youyou, the daughter of the Chairman of Li's Group, and her love Ning Yang, the secretary Xin Ran was harassed. The groom Ning Yang showed up and saved her, and they then spent a night together. At the same time, a car accident suddenly struck Chairman Li. Therefore, Ning Yang became the descendent of his place. Yet Xin Ran noticed that all the women around Ning Yang, including Li Youyou, started to disappear. The cover of Ning Yang was slowly revealed.

name: The Baby Daddy's Workbook
summary: Six years ago, An Ran, suffered a series of accidents such as the death of her mother in a car accident, accidental pregnancy, etc. After giving birth to twins, her stepsister took her son away and drove him abroad. Six years later, An Ran returned with her daughter to take revenge, finding her long-lost son and reuniting with the child's father, Situ Mo.

name: Contenders
summary: In the late 1940s, along the banks of the Malacca River, Chinese immigrants banded together to survive and thrive. By struggling together and helping each other, they finally created the Shanhai Gang after going through setback. It gradually becomes the heart of the local Chinese community. The story follows Cheng Hui. The retired leader forces back into Xingzhou when rival gangs provoke him. After the murder of the Second Master, Liu Xiongwu, a power struggle erupts—filled with betrayal, turf wars, and ambitious newcomers. Now, the second generation fights to uphold their legacy, while the third generation rises with new ideals. But as colonial powers pull the strings from the shadows, the Shanhai Gang must decide: cling to tradition or forge a new path?

name: Mackerel Falls in Love with Cat
summary: At the hotel inheritance ceremony, Wu Xiao Song dramatically met Chen Ying Zi, who was in charge of refurbishing the hotel. Chen Ying Zi became the number one public enemy of merchants in Liaohe Old Street. In order to keep the hotel, Wu Xiao Song had to bite the bullet and contact Chen Ying Zi. In order for Chen Ying Zi to successfully complete the transformation plan, she must also cross the hurdle of the family. The two butt heads but eventually became friends. They also developed a touch of affection during several exchanges. When the renovation plan came to an end, Chen Ying Zi chose kindness and used a set of ancient building protection schemes to save Wu Jia Hotel and win the trust of the merchants.

name: A Hero Without a Name
summary: It tells the story of a group of passionate young people in the 1940s who gave up their writing and joined the army when the country was in danger, and the nation was in danger. They joined the battlefield without hesitation. They carried out the struggle against the enemy with courage and tact, went through ups and downs, and devoted their youthful lives to peaceful liberation.

name: The Atypical Family
summary: A story about Bok Gwi Joo who has extraordinary abilities saving Da Hae, his fated destiny.

name: Секретный артист
summary: The whole country knows the brothers, sisters or parents of these participants. The celebrity guests in Roman Kagramanov's studio will have to guess by voice whose relative the participant taking the stage is. A musical experiment will show whether talent is inherited.

name: Adventurers – Mission Zeitreise
summary: Lola, Nevin, Paul and Kikko are at a loss: where is their computer teacher, Professor Krupnik? He disappeared overnight without a trace. In search of their teacher, the children use internet software developed by Professor Krupnik, with the help of which they go on a virtual journey through time. They delve into the past and meet outstanding personalities in world history. An exciting, but not entirely safe, tour through the global data network. Always on their heels is a hacker who wants to manipulate the course of history with the help of two dangerous online agents. A challenge for Lola, Nevin, Paul and Kikko?

name: Muertos S.L.
summary: When Gonzalo Torregrosa, owner and founder of Torregrosa Funeral Home, passes away, Dámaso Carrillo, his right-hand man in the company, doesn't hesitate that the best for the business is taking the reins himself. However, against all odds, Nieves, the septuagenarian widow, decides to take the lead in the family business, with the assistance of her inept yet enthusiastic son-in-law, Chemi, a Marketing expert, and in defiance of her daughters' plans to close the Funeral Home and start a gym. While Dámaso conspires and manipulates his colleagues against the new management, the company will face competition from Transitus Funeral Services and their expansion plans, as well as a #MeToo case that threatens Gonzalo Torregosa's legacy.

name: Moordzaken: levenslang
summary: There are 11,500 prisoners in prison in our country. Two percent of them have been sentenced to life in prison and may never be released. Crime journalist Faroek Özgünes interviews prisoners who will likely spend the rest of their lives behind bars.

name: Destination X
summary:
Destination X sees a group of contestants go on the road trip of a lifetime but they have no idea of their location. In order to win, they must figure out their mystery locations. Once they're on the blacked-out Destination X bus, the journey turns into a real-life game board, with challenges designed to offer clues as to their location, along with a few misdirects to keep them guessing.  

At the end of each episode, the contestant who places an X on a map furthest from the actual location packs their bags. The first participant to reach Destination X will be crowned the winner.

name: Vale o Escrito - A Guerra do Jogo do Bicho
summary: The "jogo do bicho" (an illegal lottery of numbers) in Rio de Janeiro is controlled by families whose leaders are also patrons of samba schools. Two of these families are experiencing bloody wars of succession.

previousepisode.name: Nova cúpula: uma revolução no bicho

name: Defiance: Fighting the Far Right
summary: The story of how - from 1976 to 1981 - Britain's Asian community stood tall against far-right violence and a rising tide of racist murders.

name: Police Interceptors: Pursuit and Capture
summary: Full-throttle documentary series featuring the UK's police in breath-taking chases.

name: Love at First Sight
summary: Love at First Sight is a dating game show with three men and three women looking for love.

name: Avenue 14
summary: Things that go bump in the night, shadows that appear at odd corners… your grandmother warned you about them, they aren't just old wives' tales. And wherever they are, aspiring journalist THURSDAY will be there to write about them. Even special investigator DANIEL can't help but be intrigued by Thursday's unconventional theories on the strange and weird cases around Singapore. As Thursday goes deeper into the rabbit hole, she discovers an intricate web of secrets that coincides with her mother's death 16 years ago. Things are not all that it seems and the duo are just discovering that a greater evil may be behind these strange cases…

name: Модный девайс
summary: New project of Reutov TV! A program from the most fashionable presenters in Russia – Alex Bentley and Victor Deluxe, authors of the super-hit "Fashionable Divan". They will talk about current electronic gadgets, devices and new technologies. Special guest and co-host, popular sexy singer Katya Sambuca!

name: Love and Revenge
summary: Saeng and Pikul had been in love, til the day of broken that lead into hate between friends. This anger pass on their child. The son of Pikul, Pakorn and the daughter of Saeng, Saengphrao, fall in love with each other. He decide to run away from infulence like Saeng to suddenly become famous singer. Because of proving her love, Saengphrao work in the music of Pakorn. Their love seem to be on rocky road due to untrust to each other since what parent taught them.

name: Secret Love
summary: Techit and Techin are twins. One is is the quiet and stern one, the other is more outspoken and outgoing. They both fall in love with the same woman. She misunderstood that her first love and the person that saved her life was Techit but actually it was Techin.

name: Городские шпионы
summary: Andrey Shpagin's team is investigating a conspiracy by a large crime syndicate to illegally mine and smuggle rough diamonds. A complex criminal mechanism disguised as a solid legal business. City spies are people we don't see. With a thousand faces up your sleeve and no room for error...

name: Дежурный ангел
summary: Evgenia, a talented surgeon at a prestigious clinic, becomes the owner of strange abilities after receiving an electric shock while trying to resuscitate a patient and suffering clinical death. Now she can communicate with the souls of the dead...

name: ShortFLIX
summary: An anthology of short dramas from a diverse and exciting range of new filmmakers telling standalone stories.

name: Éloi, en quête d'un disparu
summary: Immerse yourself in the disturbing and breathtaking world of an unsolved case. A French criminal case which gave the director the opportunity to carry out his own investigation, a thrilling investigation, certain elements of which were taken up by the French police. There remains nonetheless a "disturbing disappearance" that is unresolved but which is listed and likely to be reopened if a new clue appears.

previousepisode.name: Si tu m'attends, tu vas m'attendre toute ma vie

name: Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest
summary: The rowdiest guild in Fiore Kingdom is back! Natsu, Lucy, Gray, Erza, and the whole Fairy Tail guild tackle the legendary "100 Years Quest," tougher than any S-Class quest. Their goal: find the first wizard guild ever, located in the far north of Guiltina. Facing new gods, mysterious towns, and ominous foes, they'll have their work cut out for them. Will they succeed where no wizard has before?

name: Здесь кто-то есть...
summary: The story about a haunted house where kto-to est.

name: Appointment with Adventure
summary: Filmed live each week, this program gave viewers a glimpse of drama and adventure from around the world and from the distant and not-so-distant past. Subjects of the weekly plays included the American wars, as well as conflicts of far-away countries

name: Cavuto Live
summary: Cavuto Live, anchored by Neil Cavuto, features a breakdown of the major headlines impacting business and politics along with a rotating panel of industry experts each week.

name: One Nation with Brian Kilmeade
summary: One Nation with Brian Kilmeade: In-depth analysis of the issues and stories that matter most to Americans, while offering context and solutions to help bring the country together.

name: Mud Madness
summary: Mud Madness is a new high-octane series, which will center on the world of extreme mud racing. These races attract a unique cross-section of America and have grown exponentially in popularity thanks to a unique group of passionate and authentic characters that drive the sport. This includes everyone from chiropractors to DJs, which put it all on the line for bragging rights, and in many cases, big money. While it may appear niche on the surface, mud racing has become a serious business.

name: Башня
summary: The tower is the highest building in modern Moscow. It is a symbol of ambition, success and status. At once a terrible explosion will transform the tower into the place of imprisonment of heroes. In isolation from the outside world they will be looking for a salvation to themselves. They will cry for help, try to find the culprit, lose hope, betray each other, feel pity for themselves, remember the past, dream about the future, feel despair. Trying to find a logical explanation for what is happening they inevitably reach an impasse together and one by one. These are people, for whom space is suddenly narrowed, preventing the usual picture of the world. They will be forced to change themselves, gradually realizing that the solution of this problem is not at the entry. The tower will become an infernal machine for redemption, giving chance to survive. We will see how many trials modern men need to go through to find themselves again in this world. The tower will be exploded.

name: Sunday Night in America with Trey Gowdy
summary: Trey Gowdy will offer insightful analysis and a new outlook on the latest issues facing the country. Capitalizing on his experiences as a former prosecutor and Chairman of the House Oversight and Government Reform Committee, the former South Carolina Congressman will utilize his signature mixture of wisdom, humor and historical references to break down the latest legal and political news from across the nation. "Sunday Night in America" will offer seasoned perspective while providing viewers with the tools and information to draw their own conclusions. The program will also feature timely, solution-oriented interviews with decision makers and Washington insiders, as well as original stories of triumph and success highlighting why Americans should be optimistic about the future.

name: Pren ar y Bryn
summary: A new surreal drama. Change is on the horizon in Penwyllt and the folk who live there know that the town they once loved is about to disappear before their eyes. No one more than Margaret and Clive, who are shaken from their normal lives into the middle of a great mystery.

name: The Big Weekend Show
summary: Rotating panelists will discuss the big news of the day. Join the hosts live for reaction to the issues facing the country right now and the top stories Americans are buzzing about.

name: Fizzy and Suds
summary: Join bubbly bubbles Fizzy and Suds as they get into a lather about trains, dinosaurs, pizza, and everything in-between!

name: Evig singel
summary: We follow six involuntarily lonely souls in their ups, downs, and roadblocks in the search for a life partner. Tragicomic mockmentary about not finding love.

name: Man Cheng Yun Yu Suo Huai Zhou
summary:
Qiao Huai, the illegitimate son of the Zhou family, seeks revenge for his deceased mother, infiltrates Zhou's mansion under the guise of a new concubine for the family's eldest son. But that same night, the senior master suddenly dies, and Qiao Huai is under the watchful eye of the second young master Zhou.
It would seem the game is over, but at a critical moment the third young master intervenes, and Qiao Huai remains locked in the mansion until the circumstances of their elder brother's death are clarified.
Caught between the dragon and the tiger, Qiao Huai gradually sinks into the secrets of this prosperous family, who have been buried for years...

name: Tree on a Hill
summary: Things get messy when you least expect it. An ordinary couple find themselves in the middle of a mystery that gets the town buzzing.

name: Rise Again: The Tale of Xu Yunlong
summary: Business prodigy Xu Yunlong is highly loved within the group, which arouses the jealousy of Zhang Feng, the son of the chairman of the board of directors. In order to successfully take over the throne, Zhang Feng induced Xu Yunlong's beloved wife to betray her husband, and teamed up with him to set up a scheme to discredit Xu Yunlong. After being tortured in all kinds of ways, Zhang Feng was thrown into the river bottom. However, destiny was clear, and Xu Yunlong escaped by chance. From then on, he changed his name to "Wu Ergou" and started from scratch as a beggar's son-in-law in a noodle shop. He cheated and counterattacked all the way in the business world, vowing to defeat Zhang Feng and make a comeback!

name: Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day
summary: Join Jamie at home with his family in Essex for delicious, family-focused food for real life, every day. In this brand new series, we join the nation's favourite chef at his country home, where he's cooking up tasty, healthy recipes from his new book 7 Ways: Easy Ideas for Every Day of the Week. Inspired by his own home cooking, based around simple, crowd-pleasing family meals that are creative but pressure-free, Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day mostly uses 8 ingredients or less, with plenty of versatility based on availability and affordability. These are exciting meals that provide perfect opportunities to bring those we love together, and there really is something for all the family. With dishes this fun and fantastic, Jamie's empowering viewers to get in the kitchen and make these recipes their own and enjoy really great food every day of the week!

name: Wind Direction
summary: Seventeen-year-old Cheng Miaomiao and sixteen-year-old Cheng Yaya were born in the No. 1 Oil Extraction Plant of Linqi Oilfield, with three generations of their family working in the oilfield. Their father, Cheng Pengfei, is an ENT doctor, and their mother, Jia Daiyu, works in fleet logistics. The family moved from the northwest to the coastal base of Heping Town. In the late 1990s, Miaomiao, yearning for the outside world, planned an adventure to "welcome the return of Hong Kong" during the summer vacation of her first year of high school. She roped in her childhood friend Li Si and her best friend Hu Qiumin, but their plan failed from the start. Meanwhile, her 16-year-old brother, Cheng Yaya, went up the mountain for an archaeological expedition and was almost mistaken for a tomb raider. Their mother, Jia Daiyu, was extremely troubled, and the siblings began their chaotic high school journey. Miaomiao found herself in a friendship crisis with Li Si, while Yaya's class saw the transfer of Yuan Shanqing, the daughter of a wanted criminal. Yaya was the first to stand up and shield Yuan Shanqing from hostility from all sides. In the midst of dealing with changes and challenges, the children welcomed growth in their lives.

name: Lady Revenger Returns From the Fire
summary: Luo Ai Lian, the gentle and peaceful eldest daughter of the Luo family, lost everything overnight due to a sudden disaster and was thrown from wealth into a quagmire. After experiencing many difficulties, she finally experienced a narrow escape and became the eldest daughter of the escort agency, Shen Dan Qing, who was capable of both literary and martial arts. She was reborn from the ashes and embarked on the thorny road of tearing apart her enemies with her hands, starting her different life. In the process of revenge, Shen Dan Qing accidentally broke into the sight of General Xu, who was looking for the lost treasure, arousing his suspicion. This made Shen Dan Qing's road to revenge even more ups and downs and unique. In this thrilling battle of wits and courage, they helped each other and cherished each other, and a series of exciting stories happened.

name: Miriam Margolyes Impossibly Australian
summary: Miriam Margolyes infiltrates and sheds light on a unique Australian community. Some are struggling or facing a bleak future, others are prospering, all say something about where we are heading as a nation.

name: Creative Types with Virginia Trioli
summary: Creative Types with Virginia Trioli is a new series in which award-winning broadcaster, journalist and unabashed arts fanatic Virginia Trioli explores the essence of creativity with some of Australia's best creative minds.

name: Under the Moonlight
summary: Young girl Luo Shu was sold to a brothel as her family went broke. However, because of her kindness and acumen, she earned the nickname "Jinnang". To change her life, she volunteered to assist the new county magistrate, Han Muzhi, in solving a major case. From then on, she temporarily stayed in the county office as a constable. During this time, she met Qi Menglin, a young nobleman who wanted to make a name in the martial world. Luo Shu was good at solving bizarre cases. As ten notorious murder cases took place one after another, including the gruesome "Headless Woman Case", the eerie "Fenhe River Corpse Case", and the treacherous "Winery Murder Case", Luo Shu and Qi Menglin did everything they could to bring justice to the helpless women involved. As they solved several cases together, Luo Shu and Qi Menglin started to have feelings for each other. In the meantime, however, a bigger conspiracy began to unfold.

name: The Days of Seclusion and Love
MasterChef India – Telugu
summary: MasterChef India – Telugu is an Indian Telugu-language competitive cooking reality show based on MasterChef and is part of MasterChef India.

name: MasterChef India – Tamil
summary: MasterChef India – Tamil is an Indian Tamil-language competitive cooking reality show based on MasterChef and is part of MasterChef India.

name: Brave Eagle
summary: Follows the adventures of a young Cheyenne chief named Brave Eagle as he navigates conflicts between Native American tribes and settlers while striving to maintain peace and justice.

name: Boligkjøp i blinde
summary: Housing expert Karianne Amlie is authorized to manage five families' savings in the hunt for five dream homes. The houses are experienced as nightmares, before the renovation job fortunately begins.

name: Gigantene
summary: They are in poor shape and are afraid of the ball, but Norway's new national team still wants to go to the WC. With Ole Martin Årst as coach, they aim for the top.

name: A Splendid Match
summary: After years away from her family, Gu Jinzhao returns home and begins a remarkable transformation, from a carefree young woman into a poised and influential noble lady. As questions of marriage arise, she refuses to follow tradition and holds firmly to her own beliefs about love. But when multiple men enter her life, each offering a different future, who will Gu Jinzhao choose?

name: Blue Ridge
summary: Blue Ridge follows new sheriff, ex-Green Beret Justin Wise as he and his two deputies start investigating a murder in a town at the heart of the Blue Ridge mountains.

name: На автомате
summary: Every day of Roma and Zhenya's teenage brothers goes the same way, on the machine: alarm clock, study, cigarette behind the garage, a warehouse with weapons ... wait, what? The guys decide that this is a chance to quickly cut down easy money, because all you have to do is sell the machines on the darknet. But where there are weapons, there are dangerous people — that's where the fun begins. Very soon, all the residents of the town are involved in the story: single mother Svetlana, pawnshop owner Albert, tattoo artist Lelya, policeman Basov, his blogger daughter Milena, as well as the capital's bandits.

name: Los mil días de Allende
summary: The story of the Salvador Allende, former president of Chile, from his presidential campaign to the day of his death on 11 September 1973.

name: Ректор
summary: Lavrenty Semenovich Timoshin, or simply Lavrik, is a young, promising, but very anxious candidate of sciences, who heads the biochemistry laboratory of a serious research institute and has been developing a cure for fear for several years. Mostly from his own. Lavrik is afraid of everything — scientific achievements, his mother's anger, love and reforms at the National Research University. The latter are not long in coming. The rector of the Bogomolov Institute, who has held this position for a long time, wants to give up his post to the younger generation, and Lavrik is the best candidate. But will this position be a boon for Lavrik and will it still allow him to complete his research, especially when such drastic changes go far beyond career growth?

name: La vida secreta de tu mente
summary: Series aimed at answering common questions humans have about how their brain works.

name: Motzki
summary: Motzki is a 13-part television series created by Wolfgang Menge in 1993, which satirically commented on German-German sensitivities shortly after reunification.

name: Tack för musiken
summary: A Swedish tv-show hosted by Niklas Strömstedt. Every show includes an musicartist as a guest and are being interviewed. They also preform some of their greatest hits. It's a way of saying "thank you for the music".

name: Faster, Purple Worm! Kill! Kill!
summary: An improv-comedy spin on "Dungeons and Dragons." Each episode introduces a new party of intrepid first-level characters who must battle the most vicious D&D monsters--which they stand no chance of defeating.

name: К.О.Д.
summary: K.O.D. is a new special unit of the police of Ukraine, formed from the best specialists of the OSA agency and the Water Police. In solving highly complex criminal cases, the special unit will use artificial intelligence, which is called K.O.D.

name: Alison Hammond's Big Weekend
summary:
Alison Hammond's Big Weekend will see the much-loved TV host take the celebrity interview into an exciting new direction as she spends two days with some of the UK's biggest celebrities, giving viewers an exclusive glimpse into their homes and lives.

Each episode will see Alison spend 48 hours with a celebrity where she will really get to know them.

name: ITV Studio Sessions
summary: ITV Studio Sessions aims to champion top talent and exciting emerging artists from the UK. Audiences will also get to discover the stories that inspired the artists' work as Clara will interview the artist between songs, finding out how their tracks have had an impact on their lives and what we can expect next.

name: Destination X
summary:
Merging fantasy with reality in this larger-than-life adventure competition series, viewers will follow contestants as they embark on the road trip of a lifetime but have no idea of their location. In order to win, they must figure out their mystery locations. Once they're on the blacked-out Destination X bus, the journey transforms into a real-life board game, with challenges designed to offer clever clues as to their location, along with a few misdirects to keep them guessing.

At the end of each episode, the contestant who places an X on a map furthest from the actual location packs their bags. The first participant to reach Destination X will be crowned the winner. With high stakes and mind-blowing, spectacular gameplay, the series will keep viewers engaged and playing along on all screens.

name: Bestemming X
summary: Ten unknown Flemish people go on a spectacular and adventurous road trip across Europe. Their companion de route? A gigantic, black bus. Who finds Bestemming X?

name: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes
summary: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes is a fresh take on quick, easy, yummy meals. Rachael demonstrates her creativity and flair from her personal home kitchen, cooking a complete meal in minutes from comfort food to sophisticated fare for entertaining.

previousepisode.name: Mushroom, Truffle, and Green Tomato Pizzas

nextepisode.name: Deviled Ham Sliders, Cowboy Caviar & Green Melon Gazpacho

name: America at War
summary: Glimpses of the U.S. military in action.

name: Ace of Base - All That She Wants
summary: Ace of Base quickly became famous through MTV and number one on the charts everywhere. But at the time, no one knew about Ulf Ekberg's past in Gothenburg's far-right circles.

name: Ett liv värt
